0.question: What is CoachBot Studio?
0.answer: CoachBot Studio is a no-code platform that lets you create your own AI coaching agents (CoachBots) based on your voice, methods, and intellectual property. These agents can automate tasks that previously required your personal time — such as onboarding, follow-ups, or progress check-ins. As part of a hybrid AI + human experience, CoachBots help you deliver structured coaching or training programs at scale while making the experience even more personal.

1.question: Who is CoachBot for?
1.answer: CoachBot is built for professional coaches, mentors, trainers, L&D teams, and organizational leaders who want to scale personal development and learning with responsible AI — without replacing the human touch.

2.question: How does CoachBot work?
2.answer: CoachBot is powered by our multi-agent CORA engine (Coach-Oriented Reasoning Algorithm), which enables structured, measurable coaching conversations. You can define your tone of voice, success criteria, and conversational flow — then deploy your CoachBots across platforms like web, WhatsApp, or directly integrate them into your applications.

3.question: Is CoachBot safe and compliant?
3.answer: Yes. CoachBot is fully GDPR-compliant, hosted in the EU, and aligned with the EU AI Act. We never fine-tune models on your or your clients’ data, so your intellectual property and user privacy remain fully protected. Consent, transparency, and ethical design are core principles of our platform — we deliberately avoid anthropomorphized AI or engagement-driven behavior loops.

4.question: Can I start using it today?
4.answer: CoachBot is currently in a private beta with selected coaching businesses and organizations. You can request early access by filling out the signup form below or ask one of our existing users to refer you to us.

5.question: How is it different from other AI tools?
5.answer: Unlike generic AI bots or clones, CoachBot was built specifically for coaching and adaptive learning. It focuses on structured, ethical, and measurable transformation journeys — powered by AI, guided by humans.

0.question: What is CoachBot?
0.answer: CoachBot is an AI coaching assistant designed by certified professional coaches to guide you on your personal growth journey. Available 24/7 through your browser or WhatsApp, CoachBot helps you set and reach goals—big or small. By asking thought-provoking questions, CoachBot offers a personalized approach to help you focus on what truly matters, empowering you to succeed in your challenges.

1.question: How does AI coaching work?
1.answer: CoachBot uses a machine learning model to assess various life areas and help you prioritize your goals. After selecting a topic, CoachBot asks insightful questions to understand your challenges and provide actionable steps. This process promotes self-reflection, goal setting, and accountability, ensuring continuous personal growth.

2.question: What are the benefits of AI coaching?
2.answer: AI coaching provides the flexibility of accessing coaching whenever you need it - day or night. It's cost-effective, personalized, and adapts to your unique needs. Whether you're seeking a quick motivation boost or need help navigating a big decision, CoachBot is always there. We recommend CoachBot not only as the perfect way to dip your toes into the world of coaching before moving on to more complex or personalized support, including human coaches. AI coaching is also an excellent complement to human coaching, providing continuous guidance between sessions.

3.question: Is my data safe with CoachBot?
3.answer: Absolutely. Your privacy and security are our highest priorities. CoachBot uses advanced, industry-standard security measures to protect everything you share with us. This means your conversations and personal information are safely stored and fully protected. We use strong authentication to ensure that only you have access to your account. Rest assured, we take every step to keep your data safe so you can focus on your personal growth with confidence.

4.question: How is CoachBot different from other AI chatbots?
4.answer: CoachBot isn't just another chatbot. It is designed specifically for coaching, incorporating a personalized coaching journey tailored to your unique needs. With the LifeVision and GoalTrack tools, you can assess key life areas and track your goals, all within a seamless user interface. CoachBot also integrates with WhatsApp and other messengers for convenience and includes extra privacy and security layers, ensuring a highly personalized and secure coaching experience.

5.question: When is AI coaching not appropriate?
5.answer: While CoachBot is a great entry point for personal growth and development, it's not designed to replace medical or therapeutic advice. If you're facing serious health issues, emotional distress, or emergencies, we recommend consulting a professional therapist or medical expert.

6.question: What are the LifeVision and GoalTrack tools?
6.answer: The LifeVision assessment helps you map key areas of your life, offering a clear starting point for your personal growth. GoalTrack is a powerful feature that lets you set goals, build habits, and track your progress over time, ensuring you stay accountable on your path to success.

7.question: Is CoachBot free?
7.answer: CoachBot offers a free version with basic features, allowing you to experiment with AI coaching and get a sense of how it can support your personal growth. For users looking for more advanced features and personalized guidance, we also offer a premium version with enhanced features to dive deeper into your growth journey.

8.question: How can I contact support?
8.answer: If you have questions or need assistance, our team is here to help. Simply contact us via email at support@coachbot.ai and we'll respond promptly.

privacyStep.title: Data Protection & Privacy
privacyStep.description1: To make your coaching work better for you, we use basic info about you like your name, email, language, and what you prefer. You're always in control of what you share and can ask to see, fix, or delete your data at any time. We suggest not sharing private details such as health, religion, or race unless you think they help your goals. By sharing such info, you agree to let us use it.
privacyStep.description2: <bold>Your Rights:</bold> Under GDPR and applicable data protection laws, you can say no anytime, ask for your data, or ask for full removal of your account and chats. We follow top privacy rules and will never sell your info. Contact us at support@coachbot.ai for any data needs or questions.

transcriptSharing.title: Consent for Data Sharing
transcriptSharing.fullAccessText: Your coach has full access to your conversations to provide you with the best possible coaching experience. Your messages and details are shared with your coach.
transcriptSharing.highLevelText: Only high-level insights are shared—like conversation topics and how often you engage—while your actual messages and personal details stay private.
transcriptSharing.confidentialText: Your conversations and usage data remain fully confidential—no one has access to your chats or personal information.
transcriptSharing.description: For more details, please refer to the <privacy>Terms & Conditions.</privacy>
transcriptSharing.anknowledgeCheckbox: I consent to the processing of my data according to the privacy settings of this coach

firstStep.contentText: Welcome to Your Personal AI Coaching Experience!
firstStep.title: A Few Important Things to Know
firstStep.description1: <bold>This is an AI-based coach, not a human.</bold> I support your growth with evidence-based questions and reflective prompts aligned with global coaching ethics. I'm available 24/7 to guide your self-reflection and challenge your growth.
firstStep.description2: <bold>Important:</bold> I don't replace professional therapy, legal, medical, or financial advice. AI systems may make mistakes, so always use your own judgment. I've been trained with the highest coaching standards for quality and ethics to make the most from our sessions.

profileStep.title: Personalize Your Profile
profileStep.description1: Make your profile truly yours by adding a photo and choosing the name CoachBot will use when chatting with you for a more personal experience.
profileStep.description2: Chose your preferred language, add your mobile number to receive reminders and much more as we’re adding more personalization settings.

lifeVisionStep.title: Let’s Dive In!
lifeVisionStep.description1: <bold>LifeVision™ Assessment:</bold> This 1-minute self evaluation will help with knowing yourself a little bit better. You can use it for self reflection or to get an idea where you can start your coaching journey.

goalStep.title: Start your goal
goalStep.description1: <bold>GoalTrack:</bold> Need some inspiration on setting goals? Think where you want to be in 5 years from now and then work backwards with CoachBot to create a plan.
goalStep.description2: Set personal goals, track progress, and keep track across your priorities to achieve maximum success!

chatStep.title: Choose You Preferred Channels
chatStep.description1: <bold>Browser:</bold> Switch between Text, voice recording or voice calling are available for you, no matter if you are on your phone, tablet or desktop.
chatStep.description2: <bold>WhatsApp:</bold> If you want to be able to start or continue your conversation in Whatsapp, connect it now.
chatStep.description3: <bold>SMS/iMessage:</bold> Prefer simple texting? Connect via SMS to send and receive messages directly from your phone!
chatStep.descriptionSMS: Note: Your CoachBot creator might not have made all above channels available. If you do not see your preferred options, please get in touch via support@coachbot.ai
